response.justification: The candidate is a versatile senior full-stack/backend engineer with deep experience in TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and web/mobile systems, but shows only brief, dated C++ exposure (Dec 2014–Jun 2015 at National Instruments) and no evidence of Windows-platform C++ development at the 5-10 year level required. There is no fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience, and SQL Server/Oracle expertise is not demonstrated (only generic SQL/MySQL/MongoDB listed). This profile does not meet the mandatory technical or domain requirements of the role.
strengths: Strong overall software engineering background with 15+ years of experience across diverse platforms
Demonstrated experience with CI/CD, TDD, and software craftsmanship practices
Excellent English communication skills evident from writing, talks, and workshops
concerns: C++ experience is minimal (roughly 6 months) and outdated, far short of the 5-10 year requirement
No fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience anywhere in work history
No demonstrated SQL Server or Oracle experience, nor Windows-platform C++ development

key_factors.factor: No capital markets/fixed income domain exposure
No SQL Server/Oracle or Windows C++ evidence
